snippet.title: New Horizons Party - First Look | Club Penguin Zero Teaser Trailer
snippet.description:
Club Penguin Zero's New Horizons Party begins October 24, 2025 on opening day! In it, relive some of the history leading up to what we know as Club Penguin today, 20 years later.

While you wait to sit on that gazebo, why don't you learn about the real one located in Kelowna, Canada in Screenhog's video? https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WNzvLx71BNU

Check it out! - https://www.cpzero.net/
Twitter -   https://twitter.com/CPZeroOfficial
Discord -   https://discord.gg/N8sEcSdzwc
